action.command:
cd /workspace
# Extract credentials from .env
eval $(grep -E "^(LOCAL_USER_EMAIL|LOCAL_USER_PASSWORD|LOCAL_KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET)=" .env | sed 's/^/export /')
echo "user: $LOCAL_USER_EMAIL"
JAR=/tmp/kc-cookies.txt; rm -f $JAR
# Step 1: get login page
curl -sS -c $JAR -o /tmp/kc-login.html -w "auth-url: %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:9090/realms/local/protocol/openid-connect/auth?client_id=local-client&redirect_uri=http://localhost:3000/oauth2/callback&response_type=code&scope=openid&state=teststate"
# find execution param
EXEC=$(grep -oE 'name="execution" value="[^"]*"' /tmp/kc-login.html | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//')
echo "execution=$EXEC"
# Step 2: submit credentials
curl -sS -b $JAR -c $JAR -o /tmp/kc-login2.html -w "login-post: %{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n" \
  -X POST "http://localhost:9090/realms/local/login-actions/authenticate?client_id=local-client" \
  --data-urlencode "username=$LOCAL_USER_EMAIL" \
  --data-urlencode "password=$LOCAL_USER_PASSWORD" \
  --data-urlencode "execution=$EXEC" \
  --data-urlencode "signup=false"
grep -oE 'error=[a-z-]+' /tmp/kc-login2.html | head -2
